model.promotion_notes:
PROMOTED on 2026-09-03: XGBoost challenger tested against the Logistic Regression baseline using a paired t-test over the SAME 5 StratifiedKFold folds (random_state=42, identical between cross_validate_baseline_v2.py and cross_validate_challenger_v2.py) — the same rigorous method used in v1, which in v1's case led to REJECTING XGBoost. Here the result is the opposite: XGBoost wins in 5/5 folds consistently (AUC diff ranging +0.0065 to +0.0105 across folds, no fold where it loses), with AUC +0.0084 (p=0.0002) and KS +0.0144 (p=0.0005) — both comfortably below the 0.05 significance threshold. This closes most of the performance gap between v2 and v1 (v1 baseline AUC=0.7664 vs v2 XGBoost AUC=0.7636, vs v2 Logistic Regression AUC=0.7551). Promoting XGBoost as the v2 production model on this evidence. Interpretability is reduced versus the Logistic Regression baseline, but SHAP-based explainability (see explain_model equivalent for v2, once built) restores per-request reason codes, same approach as v1's xgb_challenger before its own reversal.

IMPORTANT HONESTY NOTE (added after ablation_check_ext_source_v2.py, 2026-09-03): SHAP analysis (explain_model_v2.py) showed EXT_SOURCE_1/2/3 — precomputed external scores present in the raw application_train.csv, not features built by this project — dominating feature importance by a wide margin. An ablation test confirmed: these 3 columns alone account for +0.0507 AUC (0.7651 with vs. 0.7144 without). Without them, v2 (0.7144) falls clearly BELOW v1's baseline (0.7664, -0.0520) — meaning the 'v2 nearly closes the gap with v1' result depends mostly on precomputed external scores, not on this project's own multi-table feature engineering (bureau, previous applications, installments, credit card behavior). Availability check (check_ext_source_missingness.py) found no production-availability risk justifying their removal (EXT_SOURCE_2 missing only 0.2% of the time; only 0.06% of clients lack all three, with no meaningful risk difference) — so they remain in the production model. But the honest accounting is: this project's engineered behavioral features (PCT_INSTALLMENTS_LATE, CC_AVG_UTILIZATION, EVER_OVERDUE, etc.) are real and individually validated with dose-response evidence during EDA, but they are secondary contributors to this model's overall performance, not the primary driver of it.
